independence.author_rebuild: Existing submitted claim only; retained separately from this review.
independence.reviewer_rebuild: Reviewer invoked the unchanged author generator into a fresh output and compared complete STL bytes. Same modelling algorithm; not a second independently authored model.
independence.reviewer_geometry: Separate struct parser, exact binary32 equal-coordinate merging, topology, integer/Fraction exhaustive pair intersection; no author QA/trimesh/manifold3d used for these tests.
independence.reviewer_sections: Separate segment/plane intersections, polygonization and material parity; finite sampling.
independence.reviewer_scene: Separate evaluated world mesh/oriented multiset and actual units/object inspection, one front render and decoded pixel comparison.
independence.author_qa_execution_audit: Tracing and rerunning the submitted QA is execution/claim auditing, not an independent algorithm.

exact_topology.merge_policy: Exact equality of binary32 coordinate triples; no rounding, repair, or trimesh processing

exact_triangle_pairs.method: Every unordered pair: exact integer AABB exclusion, then all six edge/closed-triangle intersection tests using rational segment-plane and 2-D segment tests. Any contact beyond the exact indexed shared edge or vertex is rejected.
exact_triangle_pairs.coordinate_arithmetic: Python integers and fractions, exact for binary32 STL coordinates; no floating tolerance in pair tests
exact_triangle_pairs.limitation: A reproducible exact-coordinate algorithmic check, not an independently machine-verified formal proof or a physical-print guarantee.

dense_sections.method: Own triangle/plane segments (XY rounded to 1e-8 mm), polygonize and odd crossing material parity; no candidate QA or trimesh functions used.
dense_sections.sampling: 0.02 mm midpoint grid plus every vertex-event interval midpoint and points 1e-6 mm above/below events, excluding exactly coplanar event levels.
limitations: Still finite section sampling; event-augmented grid examines all mesh vertex-height intervals but does not certify arbitrary 3-D minimum thickness.
The 45 degree envelope is a geometric support rule, not extrusion paths, bridges, cooling, shrinkage, adhesion, strength, or a test print.
A section core may survive while an attached taper is thinner than the test width; exact roof and eave tips converge to zero thickness.

retained_limitations: No physical test print or machine-specific slicer/G-code verification.
201 author sections and 2043 reviewer sections are finite samples, not a global 3D minimum-thickness proof.
Dense sections expose thin mathematical ridge tip; last 0.074849 mm is below 0.8 mm horizontal width, accepted with existing disclosure.
Facade details, unknown faces, eave/ridge heights and print base are explicitly simplified or estimated.
Numerical checks do not certify extrusion, cooling, strength, adhesion, all scales, materials or machines.
Generic verifier hardening suggestions remain nonblocking because this fixed candidate was separately checked.
